metadata.name: cubic_pool
metadata.description: Cubic Pool DEX - Multi-pool DEX with virtual liquidity and leverage logic

instructions.name: accept_pool_admin_transfer
docs: Step 2 — pending admin claims.

instructions.name: accept_protocol_admin_transfer
docs: Step 2 — pending admin claims.

instructions.name: add_liquidity
docs: Add proportional liquidity and mint BPT to the user.
# Parameters
* `token_amounts`     — per-token deposit amounts in pool order.
* `minimum_bpt_amount`— slippage floor on BPT received.
# Used by
User wallets, single-token-liquidity helper.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the BPT mint (same one used for `bpt_mint`).
Per-token programs come via `remaining_accounts` because each
pool token may use a different program.

instructions.name: cancel_pool_admin_transfer
docs: Cancel a pending pool-admin transfer.

instructions.name: cancel_protocol_admin_transfer
docs: Cancel a pending protocol-admin transfer.

instructions.name: collect_protocol_fees
docs: Sweep `protocol_fees_owed` for every token to caller-supplied
recipients and zero the counters.
# Authority
`protocol_admin` AND Treasury PDA.
# remaining_accounts
`[vault_i, recipient_i, token_program_i]` per token.
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_collect_protocol_fees` (CPI).

instructions.name: debug_withdraw_liquidity
docs: Emergency drain — pool becomes BRICKED.
`actual_balances` and `virtual_balances` are intentionally NOT
updated. Once vaults are drained out-of-band the invariant math
is meaningless, so the pool MUST stay `pool_enabled = false`
forever. Re-enabling would let users swap/join against stale
state and extract value at LP / protocol expense.
# Authority
`protocol_admin` AND Treasury PDA.
# Prerequisites
`pool.pool_enabled == false` (handler enforces).
# Parameters
* `token_amounts` — per-token withdraw amounts (use 0 to skip).
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_debug_withdraw_liquidity` (CPI),
driven by `admin-panel/03-emergency-withdraw.ts`.

instructions.name: disable_pool_admin
docs: Permanently renounce pool-admin on this pool. Single-step,
irreversible.

instructions.name: get_pool_info
docs: Read-only "view": emit a `PoolInfo` event with the pool's full
state. Intended for `simulate({ commitment: ... })` calls; not
useful as part of a signed transaction.
# Used by
SDK helpers, frontend pool-detail pages, indexer health-check
fallback.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Initialise a new `CubicPoolConfig`. Treasury wrapper passes the
Treasury PDA as both admin pubkeys; direct calls produce
Initialise a fresh `CubicPoolConfig`.
# Parameters
* `protocol_admin`           — pubkey allowed to pause pools, set
`protocol_fee_rate`, collect fees, drain via debug-withdraw,
update banned extensions, and rotate itself via the
pending/accept flow.
* `default_protocol_fee_rate`— seeded onto every new pool under
this config (basis points, ≤ `MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE_RATE`).
Pool-admin (level-1) is per-pool — set automatically to the wallet
that calls `initialize_cubic_pool`.

accounts.name: protocol_admin_treasury
docs: `seeds` + `seeds::program` constraint Anchor enforces here is
the entire validation — any account passed in that isn't that
exact PDA fails before the handler runs. The handler then
requires the `protocol_admin` argument to equal this account's
key, so on-chain `config.protocol_admin` can only ever be the
Treasury PDA.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent for `config`. Must be a `Signer`.

instructions.name: initialize_cubic_pool
docs: Initialise a fresh pool under `config`. Creates the pool PDA and
BPT mint, validates token mints / weights / virtual balances, and
pins per-token programs.
# Parameters
* `tokens`                   — pool token mints, length 2..=10,
unique.
* `normalized_weights`       — basis points, sum = `WEIGHT_SCALE`.
* `initial_virtual_balances` — seed virtual balances (raw units),
each > 0.
* `swap_fee_rate`            — hundredths of bps,
≤ `MAX_SWAP_FEE_RATE`.
* `pool_id`                  — caller-chosen 64-bit salt baked
into PDA seeds. Unique per config.
# remaining_accounts
One mint account per token in `tokens` order.
# Used by
SDK `PoolFactoryClient.buildDeployPoolTx`, deploy-pool scripts.

accounts.name: config
docs: Parent governance config. Read-only — only its pubkey and the
`default_protocol_fee_rate` / `banned_extensions` are consumed.

accounts.name: pool
docs: New pool PDA. Seeded so multiple pools per config are possible
via distinct `pool_id` values.

accounts.name: bpt_mint
docs: Brand-new BPT mint. Authority is the pool PDA, decimals fixed at
`BPT_DECIMALS` (= 9). `mint::token_program` follows the
`token_program` account passed below — this only constrains BPT,
not the per-pool tokens.

instructions.name: initialize_pool_alt
docs: Provision a per-pool Address Lookup Table so client SDKs can build
`VersionedTransaction`s for `add_liquidity` / `remove_liquidity` on
pools whose account count exceeds the legacy 1232-byte ceiling
(≥ 7 tokens in practice).
# Parameters
* `recent_slot` — recent slot used by the ALT program to derive
the table address. Caller should pass
`connection.getSlot('finalized')`.
# Flow
One transaction performs three CPIs into the ALT program:
`create_lookup_table` → `extend_lookup_table` (pool, BPT mint,
vaults, mints, standard programs) → `freeze_lookup_table`.
The ALT becomes immutable forever — its rent (~0.005 SOL for a
7-token pool) is permanently locked.
# Authority
`pool.pool_admin`. Idempotent: rejects with `AltAlreadyInitialized`
if `pool.lookup_table != Pubkey::default()`.
# Used by
`scripts/cli/initialize-pool-alts.ts` (one-shot bootstrap for
existing prod pools), and `sdk` after `initialize_cubic_pool` on
fresh pools.

accounts.name: pool
docs: Pool to provision the ALT for. Must have `lookup_table ==
Pubkey::default()`. The handler writes the new ALT address back
onto this account.

accounts.name: config
docs: `CubicPoolConfig` this pool inherits governance from. Pinned via
`pool.config`. Reading it lets the handler also accept
`config.protocol_admin` as an authority — which is the Treasury
PDA, only signable through `protocol_admin.pool_initialize_alt`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Authority. Must equal either `pool.pool_admin` (per-pool owner
path) or `config.protocol_admin` (Treasury PDA via the
protocol-admin CPI wrapper). Authorises the ALT creation; the
derived ALT address is `[authority, recent_slot]`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Payer for ALT rent + per-extend top-ups. Decoupled from
`authority` because Treasury PDA (the wrapper-path authority)
owns data and so cannot be `from` in `system_program::transfer`.
In the pool-admin path callers pass the same key for both — no
behavioural change.

accounts.name: lookup_table
docs: `[authority, recent_slot]` by the ALT program. Re-derived and
matched against this account in the handler.

accounts.name: alt_program
docs: `solana_address_lookup_table_interface::id()` in the handler.

instructions.name: initiate_pool_admin_transfer
docs: Step 1 — current `pool.pool_admin` proposes a successor.

instructions.name: initiate_protocol_admin_transfer
docs: Step 1 — current `config.protocol_admin` proposes a successor.

instructions.name: migrate_to_v5
docs: Pool storage migration entrypoint. Currently a **no-op placeholder**
— the historical one-shot migration is complete and its logic has
been removed. Kept as a generic shell so a future storage-layout
change can be implemented here without adding a new instruction.
See `instructions::migrate_to_v5`.

accounts.name: config
docs: Parent config — used only to authorise via `protocol_admin`.

instructions.name: range_manager_update
docs: Tweak any subset of `virtual_balances` and / or `normalized_weights`
within the configured envelope. Range-manager only.
# Parameters
* `vb_changes`     — sparse `[(index, new_vb)]`; may be empty.
* `weight_changes` — sparse `[(index, new_weight_bps)]`; may be
empty. The resulting weight vector must sum to `WEIGHT_SCALE`
and stay within `[MIN_WEIGHT, MAX_WEIGHT]` per token, otherwise
the whole instruction reverts.

accounts.name: pool
docs: Mutated — handler writes new virtual_balances / normalized_weights
and bumps `range_manager_last_updated`.

instructions.name: remove_liquidity
docs: Burn BPT proportionally and pay out tokens.
# Minimum-supply floor
The pool always retains at least `MINIMUM_INITIAL_BPT` of supply
so the proportional math never sees a zero-supply state. If the
caller's `bpt_amount` would push supply below the floor, the burn
is silently capped at `total_supply - MINIMUM_INITIAL_BPT` and
the residual BPT stays in the user's wallet.
# Parameters
* `bpt_amount`            — caller's requested burn (raw BPT).
* `minimum_token_amounts` — per-token slippage floors against the
*effective* (capped) burn.
# Used by
User wallets, SDK `LiquidityClient`.

instructions.name: set_banned_extensions
docs: Update the Token-2022 banned-extensions bitmap on a config.
Only affects future pool inits.
# Authority
`protocol_admin` AND Treasury PDA.
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_set_banned_extensions` (CPI).

instructions.name: set_max_selloff
docs: Set the per-token sell-off policy — sliding-window cap, period, and
the variable surge-fee curve — for every active token in one call.
Pool-admin only.
# Parameters
* `params` — length == `token_count`, one
`instructions::set_max_selloff::SelloffParams` per token
(`max_selloff_pct`, `period_length`, `fee_threshold_pct`,
`fee_slope_low_pct`, `fee_slope_high_pct`; all `_pct` in
`PERCENT_SCALE` units). The surge fee rises convexly as the
window fills and is charged on the output token, 100% to the
protocol bucket.

instructions.name: set_pool_enabled
docs: Master pool kill-switch. When `enabled = false`, swaps and
add/remove liquidity all revert.
# Authority
`protocol_admin` AND Treasury PDA.
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_set_pool_enabled` (CPI).

instructions.name: set_protocol_fee_rate
docs: Set `pool.protocol_fee_rate`.
# Authority
`protocol_admin` AND Treasury PDA.
# Parameters
* `protocol_fee_rate` — basis points, ≤ `MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE_RATE`.
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_set_protocol_fee_rate` (CPI).

instructions.name: set_range_manager
docs: Set or disable the range-manager pubkey on `pool`. Pool-admin only —
protocol-admin cannot reach this. Combine `new_manager =
Pubkey::default()` with `enabled = false` for the fully-disabled
state. New pools deploy with this off by default.
# Parameters
* `new_manager` — pubkey allowed to call `range_manager_update`.
* `enabled`     — gate flag; `false` blocks the manager even if
pubkey is set.

instructions.name: set_range_manager_config
docs: Configure the envelope the range-manager must stay within. Pool-
admin only. Limits are per-token (applied independently in the
update loop) and a percentage of the CURRENT value, in
`PERCENT_SCALE` units (10_000 = 100%).
# Parameters
* `max_weight_change_pct`    — ≤ 10_000.
* `min_update_interval_secs` — rate-limit between successive
`range_manager_update` calls.

instructions.name: set_swap_fee_rate
docs: Set `pool.swap_fee_rate`.
# Authority
`pool_admin` AND Treasury PDA.
# Parameters
* `swap_fee_rate` — hundredths of bps, ≤ `MAX_SWAP_FEE_RATE`.
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_set_swap_fee_rate` (CPI).

accounts.name: pool
docs: Mutated. `authority` must equal `pool.pool_admin` (storage-only
admin pubkey; no hardcoded address).

instructions.name: set_swaps_enabled
docs: Per-pool swap toggle (less invasive than `set_pool_enabled` —
LPs can still add/remove liquidity).
# Authority
`pool_admin` OR `protocol_admin`, AND Treasury PDA.
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_set_swaps_enabled` (CPI).

instructions.name: set_token_active
docs: Set a token's `is_active` flag. When `false`, swaps whose INPUT token
is `token_index` revert (`TokenInactive`); the token can still be
bought (as output) and liquidity ops are unaffected.
# Authority
`pool.pool_admin` OR `config.protocol_admin` (Treasury PDA). The
Treasury path is reachable by admin OR supervisor via
`protocol_admin::pool_set_token_active`.

instructions.name: swap
docs: Swap one pool token for another using `calc_out_given_in`.
# Parameters
* `amount_in`         — raw input token units (pre-fee).
* `minimum_amount_out`— slippage floor.
* `token_in_index`    — index in `pool.token_mints`.
* `token_out_index`   — different index in `pool.token_mints`.
# Used by
User wallets, SDK `SwapClient`, single-token-liquidity helper.

accounts.name: user_token_account_in
docs: User's input-token account. Mint and owner cross-checked.

accounts.name: vault_in
docs: Pool input vault. ATA(pool, mint_in, token_program_in) — verified
in handler.

instructions.name: withdraw_sol
docs: Drain lamports from a cubic-pool-owned account, leaving at least
the rent-exempt minimum.
# Authority
Treasury PDA only.
# Parameters
* `amount` — lamports; must be > 0 and ≤
`source.lamports() - rent_exempt_minimum(source.data_len())`.
# Used by
`protocol_admin::pool_withdraw_sol` (CPI).

types.name: AssetConfig
docs: `CubicPool` v4 — per-pool state for a weighted AMM with virtual liquidity.
Storage layout: **Array-of-Structs (AoS)**. Per-token data lives in
`tokens: [TokenSlot; MAX_TOKENS]`. Each `TokenSlot` carries TWO nested
sub-structs:
- `config: AssetConfig`     — admin-controlled, rarely changes (mint,
token_program, weight, max_selloff, period).
- `dynamics: AssetDynamics` — auto-updated by user txs (balances,
protocol_fees_owed, sliding-window selloff state).
This mirrors Solend / MarginFi / Kamino's `Reserve { config, ... }`
pattern. Reading per-token data is a single struct lookup; auditors
see at a glance which fields a user can mutate vs which need pool
admin authority.
## Storage layout — DO NOT REORDER
Backends (`onchainPoolFetcher.ts`, indexer) read fields by raw offset.
Adding fields is OK if appended at the END (before the trailing
`reserved`) and `reserved` shrinks accordingly. Inserting in the
middle would require rewriting existing accounts.
## Derived (not stored) state
- `bpt_mint`        — derived as `[BPT_MINT_SEED, pool]` PDA.
- `bpt_total_supply`— read from `bpt_mint.supply` at runtime.
- `token_vaults[i]` — derived as ATA(pool, mint, tokens[i].config.token_program).
- `token_decimals`  — read from each mint account at runtime.

fields.name: mint
docs: Token mint pubkey for this slot. `Pubkey::default()` past `token_count`.

fields.name: token_program
docs: SPL Token or Token-2022 program ID for this token's vault/transfers.

fields.name: normalized_weight
docs: Normalised weight in basis points (sum across active slots == 10_000).

fields.name: max_selloff_pct
docs: Max cumulative sell volume of this token per sliding window,
expressed as a **percentage of the token's `virtual_balance`**
captured at window start, in units of `PERCENT_SCALE` (10_000 =
100%, so 1000 = 10%; resolution 0.01%). `0` disables the check for
this token. Must be `<= PERCENT_SCALE`. Set by pool_admin only.
The absolute cap for a window is `floor(max_selloff_pct *
vb_snapshot / PERCENT_SCALE)`, where `vb_snapshot` is
`AssetDynamics::selloff_vb_snapshot` (taken at window open). Using a
per-window snapshot — not the live `virtual_balance` — prevents an
in-window base-inflation bypass (see `math::max_selloff`).

fields.name: max_selloff_period_length
docs: Length of the sliding window in seconds. Ignored when
`max_selloff_pct == 0`. Set by pool_admin only.

fields.name: variable_fee_threshold_pct
docs: Variable sell-off **surge fee** curve (per token, `PERCENT_SCALE`
units; 10_000 = 100%). The fee rises as the token's max-selloff
window fills and is charged on `amount_out`, routed 100% to the
protocol bucket (`protocol_fees_owed`), never to LPs. See
`math::surge_fee`. The fee is active only when `max_selloff_pct > 0`
(it reads the window fill ratio) AND `fee_slope_high_pct > 0`.
Window fill ratio at which the surge fee starts (below it the fee is
0). E.g. 8000 = surge begins at 80% window fill.

fields.name: variable_fee_slope_low_pct
docs: Surge fee at the threshold (lower point of the curve).

fields.name: variable_fee_slope_high_pct
docs: Surge fee at ~100% window fill (upper point of the curve). Must be
`>= fee_slope_low_pct` and `<= PERCENT_SCALE`.

fields.name: is_active
docs: Per-token kill switch for the **input** side of swaps. When `false`,
swaps whose INPUT token is this one revert (`TokenInactive`); the
token can still be bought (as swap output) and liquidity ops are
unaffected. Defaults to `true` (active). Flipped by `set_token_active`
(pool-admin or protocol-admin/supervisor). Used to stop accepting a
compromised token without pausing the whole pool.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Future-compat (do not repurpose).

fields.name: virtual_balance
docs: Virtual balance (raw token units) used by the cubic invariant
math. Decoupled from `actual_balance` to enable concentrated
liquidity. Updated by swap / add_liquidity / remove_liquidity.

fields.name: actual_balance
docs: Mirrors the on-chain vault balance for this token. Always equals
the vault's `amount` after every successful tx (CEI ordering
keeps them in sync).

fields.name: protocol_fees_owed
docs: Accumulated protocol fees for this token (raw units), awaiting
`collect_protocol_fees`. Stored separately from `actual_balance`
so LP value isn't diluted by uncollected fees.

fields.name: previous_selloff
docs: Sliding-window rate limiter: amount sold in the PREVIOUS window
(Cloudflare-style approximation, Solend RateLimiter pattern).

fields.name: current_selloff
docs: Amount sold in the CURRENT window.

fields.name: window_start_timestamp
docs: `Clock::unix_timestamp` when the current window started. Set to
`now()` at pool init.

fields.name: selloff_vb_snapshot
docs: Snapshot of this token's `virtual_balance` taken when the current
max-selloff window opened. The window's absolute cap is
`floor(config.max_selloff_pct * selloff_vb_snapshot / PERCENT_SCALE)`.
Snapshotting (rather than reading live `virtual_balance`) keeps the
cap un-inflatable within a window — selling raises the live vb, but
not this snapshot. `0` ⇒ uninitialised (re-captured on next check).

types.name: BannedExtensionsUpdated
docs: Emitted by `set_banned_extensions`. Off-chain validators use this to
refresh the cached blocklist without rereading the config account.

types.name: ConfigInitialized
docs: Emitted at the end of `initialize_config`. Marks a new `CubicPoolConfig`
account live, with `protocol_admin` pinned to the Treasury PDA.
`initialize_config` creates the account from scratch, so there are no
"old" values to carry — every field is reported as its initial value.
# Fields
* `config`                    — the new config PDA pubkey
* `protocol_admin`            — Treasury PDA the config is pinned to
* `default_protocol_fee_rate` — seeded onto every pool from this config
* `banned_extensions`         — initial Token-2022 extension blocklist
* `payer`                     — account that paid rent / signed init
* `timestamp`                 — `Clock::unix_timestamp` at init

fields.name: config
docs: `CubicPoolConfig` this pool inherits governance from. Pinned at
init, used both as a PDA seed and at runtime in admin-instruction
constraints (`pool.config == config.key()`).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for the pool PDA. Stored so signer-seed reconstruction is
O(1) instead of an expensive `find_program_address` per CPI.

fields.name: token_count
docs: Number of active tokens in the pool, in [MIN_TOKENS, MAX_TOKENS] =
[2, 10]. Slots beyond `token_count` are zeroed and ignored.

fields.name: pool_id
docs: User-chosen 64-bit salt baked into the PDA seeds, allowing multiple
pools per config without re-deploying. Unique per (config, pool_id).

fields.name: swap_fee_rate
docs: Swap fee in hundredths of a basis point (precision
`SWAP_FEE_PRECISION` = 1_000_000). 100_000 = 10% (current cap).

fields.name: protocol_fee_rate
docs: Share of each swap fee taken by the protocol, in basis points
(precision `PROTOCOL_FEE_PRECISION` = 10_000). 5_000 = 50% (cap).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Pool creation `Clock::unix_timestamp`. Informational only.

fields.name: pool_enabled
docs: Master kill switch — when `false`, swaps and add/remove liquidity
all revert. Only `protocol_admin` can flip this.

fields.name: swaps_enabled
docs: Trading switch — `false` blocks swaps but still allows LP
add/remove. Either `pool_admin` or `config.protocol_admin` can flip.

fields.name: pool_admin
docs: Per-pool admin. Owns: rotate swap_fee_rate, toggle swaps_enabled,
set range_manager, set max_selloff, transfer/disable itself.

fields.name: pending_pool_admin
docs: Pending successor for `pool_admin` during a 2-step transfer.

fields.name: range_manager
docs: Pubkey allowed to call `range_manager_update`. `Pubkey::default()`
⇒ no manager set.

fields.name: range_manager_enabled
docs: `false` ⇒ all `range_manager_update` calls revert.

fields.name: range_manager_max_vb_change_pct
docs: Max per-update change to a token's `virtual_balance`, as a
percentage of its current value, in `PERCENT_SCALE` units
(10_000 = 100%; 500 = 5%). Enforced per token in
`range_manager_update`.

fields.name: range_manager_max_weight_change_pct
docs: Max per-update change to a token's `normalized_weight`, same
`PERCENT_SCALE` units.

fields.name: tokens
docs: All per-token state. Slot `i` is for the i-th token. Slots past
`token_count` are zero-initialised and ignored.

fields.name: lookup_table
docs: Per-pool Address Lookup Table address. Holds pool-scoped accounts
(pool PDA, BPT mint, vaults, mints, token programs) so client SDKs
can build VersionedTransactions for `add_liquidity` / `remove_liquidity`
without hitting the 1232-byte legacy-tx ceiling on multi-token pools.
`Pubkey::default()` ⇒ ALT not yet initialised. SDK falls back to
legacy tx (will only work for small pools). Set by `initialize_pool_alt`,
frozen on-chain so depositors don't worry about authority abuse.

fields.name: banned_extensions
docs: Token-2022 extension blocklist that was applied to THIS pool's tokens
at creation, in the same bit layout as
`CubicPoolConfig.banned_extensions` (bit `i` set ⇒ extension type `i`
is forbidden). Chosen by the pool **creator** at init: if they passed
an explicit override it is stored verbatim; otherwise the parent
config's default was copied here.
Recorded for transparency so indexers / depositors can see exactly
which extension policy a pool's tokens were vetted against. It is a
snapshot only — the pool's token set is fixed at creation, so changing
this value later would not re-validate anything.
NOTE (security): the creator may set ANY bitmap, including `0` (allow
every extension). A pool whose policy permits e.g. `PermanentDelegate`
or `TransferHook` can be drained/abused by the token issuer — LPs must
read this field and decide whether they trust the policy before
depositing. Pre-existing (pre-upgrade) pools read `0` here.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compat padding for pool-level fields.

types.name: CubicPoolConfig
docs: `CubicPoolConfig` — protocol-level governance for every pool created
against this account.
One config can host many pools (each pool stores `config: Pubkey`).
Per-pool admin (level-1: rotates `swap_fee_rate`, toggles `swaps_enabled`)
lives on `CubicPool::pool_admin`. This config carries only the
protocol-level admin (level-2) plus protocol-wide defaults.

fields.name: protocol_admin
docs: Protocol-level admin. Allowed to: pause pools, change
`protocol_fee_rate`, collect protocol fees, drain via
`debug_withdraw_liquidity`, update `banned_extensions`, withdraw
SOL from program-owned accounts, and rotate itself via the
pending/accept flow. Set to a designated authority (typically the
Treasury PDA of the `protocol-admin` program) at config init.

fields.name: pending_protocol_admin
docs: Pending successor for `protocol_admin` during a 2-step transfer.
`Pubkey::default()` ⇒ no transfer in flight.

fields.name: default_protocol_fee_rate
docs: Default `protocol_fee_rate` (in basis points, max 5000 = 50%) seeded
onto every new pool created against this config. Pools may diverge
later via `set_protocol_fee_rate`.

fields.name: banned_extensions
docs: Bitmap of banned Token-2022 extension types. Bit N set ⇒ extension
type N is rejected at pool init. Maintained by `protocol_admin` via
`set_banned_extensions`. Defaults to `DEFAULT_BANNED_EXTENSIONS`
(TransferFee, ConfidentialTransfer, NonTransferable, …).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Forward-compatibility padding so future fields can be added without
migrating existing config accounts.

types.name: DebugLiquidityWithdrawn
docs: Emitted by `debug_withdraw_liquidity`. Listening for this event is the
canonical way for off-chain monitors to know that a pool has
transitioned to the "bricked" state — `actual_balances` and
`virtual_balances` no longer match vault holdings after this fires.

types.name: LiquidityAdded
docs: Emitted by `add_liquidity` after BPT is minted.
# Fields
* `token_amounts` — what the user actually deposited (raw units, in
pool order)
* `bpt_amount`    — BPT minted to the user

types.name: LiquidityRemoved
docs: Emitted by `remove_liquidity` after BPT is burned. `bpt_amount` is the
**effective** burn (capped to `total_supply - MINIMUM_INITIAL_BPT`),
not the original request — clients reading this know exactly how much
supply changed.

types.name: MaxSelloffSet
docs: Emitted by `set_max_selloff`. `max_selloff_pct` and
`max_selloff_period_length` are the post-update arrays of length
`token_count`. `max_selloff_pct[i]` is a percent of token i's virtual
balance in `PERCENT_SCALE` units (10_000 = 100%); `0` disables the
check for token i.

fields.name: fee_threshold_pct
docs: Surge-fee curve, per token (PERCENT_SCALE units).

fields.name: old_max_selloff_pct
docs: Pre-update arrays (same length/order as the `*_pct` arrays above)
for each of the five mutated per-token fields. Appended (wire
append-only) so indexers get the full before/after of the policy.

types.name: MaxSelloffWindowAdvanced
docs: Emitted from inside `swap` whenever the sliding-window check for
`token_in_index` runs — this is the per-swap max-selloff WINDOW-FILL log.
Window fill = `effective_selloff / max_selloff_cap` (0..1). Carries the
resolved absolute cap and the vb-snapshot it was resolved against, plus
the raw window components (previous/current selloff, window_start).
The static config `max_selloff_pct` is intentionally NOT included here
(it does not change during a swap) — it is logged by `MaxSelloffSet`
when the policy changes, and `cap = pct * vb_snapshot / PERCENT_SCALE`.

types.name: PoolAltInitialized
docs: Emitted by `initialize_pool_alt` once the ALT is created, extended
with all pool-scoped addresses, and frozen. Off-chain SDK / indexer
uses this as the signal that v0 transactions are usable for this pool.

fields.name: pool
docs: Pool PDA.

fields.name: lookup_table
docs: Address Lookup Table account created.

fields.name: authority
docs: Wallet that authored creation (matches `pool.pool_admin` at the
time of the call). After freeze the ALT has no authority.

fields.name: address_count
docs: Number of addresses written into the ALT.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: `Clock::unix_timestamp` at initialisation.

types.name: PoolEnabledUpdated
docs: Emitted by `set_pool_enabled`.

types.name: PoolInfo
docs: Read-only view event emitted by the simulation-only `get_pool_info`
instruction. Off-chain clients call `simulate({ commitment: ... })`
and parse this event from the returned logs. Strictly more verbose
than `PoolStateLog` (also includes derived addresses).

types.name: PoolInitialized
docs: Emitted at the end of `initialize_cubic_pool`. Marks a new pool live.
# Fields
* `pool`        — pool PDA pubkey
* `config`      — parent config pubkey
* `token_count` — active tokens (2..=10)
* `bpt_mint`    — BPT mint PDA pubkey
* `timestamp`   — `Clock::unix_timestamp` at init
* `banned_extensions` — the effective Token-2022 extension blocklist the
creator's tokens were vetted against (override, or the config default).

fields.name: banned_extensions
docs: Appended (wire append-only): effective per-pool banned-extensions bitmap.

types.name: PoolMigratedToV5
docs: Emitted by `migrate_to_v5`. Marks an in-place storage migration that
re-interprets the (same-size, 1683-byte) v4 account under a newer field
layout: the bytes that previously held `max_selloff: u64` /
`max_selloff_period_length: u32` / `reserved` now decode as
`max_selloff_pct` + the surge-fee curve + `is_active`. The only field
that needs a value rewrite is `is_active` — pre-migration it decodes as
`false` (old `reserved[0] == 0`), so the migration flips every active
token's `is_active` back to `true` (the intended default).

fields.name: reactivated
docs: How many token slots were flipped from inactive→active (0 ⇒ pool was
already migrated / created post-upgrade — idempotent no-op).

types.name: PoolSolWithdrawn
docs: Emitted by `withdraw_sol` when SOL is recovered from a cubic-pool-owned
account.

types.name: PoolStateLog
docs: Mutating-instruction state snapshot consumed by the backend indexer to
keep its denormalised pool table in sync without an additional account
fetch. Emitted by `swap`, `add_liquidity`, and `remove_liquidity`.
NOTE: BPT total supply is intentionally NOT included — it is redundant
with the BPT mint account (which indexers already stream) and was a
misleading hardcoded `0` on `swap`. Read supply from the mint at the
tx slot instead.

types.name: ProtocolFeeRateUpdated
docs: Emitted by `set_protocol_fee_rate`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Protocol admin (Treasury PDA) that changed the rate. Appended.

types.name: ProtocolFeesCollected
docs: Emitted by `collect_protocol_fees` once per call (one event covers all
tokens, with zero-amounts kept in `token_amounts` to preserve order).

types.name: RangeManagerConfigSet
docs: Emitted by `set_range_manager_config`. Carries the full effective
envelope so off-chain indexers don't need to re-fetch the pool.

fields.name: max_vb_change_pct
docs: New percent-of-current-value change caps, in `PERCENT_SCALE` units

fields.name: old_max_vb_change_pct
docs: Pre-update values of the three fields above. Appended (wire
append-only) so indexers get the full before/after.

types.name: RangeManagerSet
docs: Emitted by `set_range_manager`. Both the pubkey and the enabled flag
are bundled into a single event. `new_manager == Pubkey::default()`
AND `enabled = false` is the "fully disabled" state.

fields.name: enabled
docs: New value of `range_manager_enabled` (kept for back-compat; the
`old_enabled`/`new_enabled` pair below carries the full before/after).

fields.name: old_enabled
docs: Before/after of `range_manager_enabled`. Appended (wire append-only).

types.name: RangeManagerUpdated
docs: Emitted by `range_manager_update` after every check passes and state
is committed. `vb_indices` / `vb_new_values` and `weight_indices` /
`weight_new_values` are aligned slices (may be empty).

types.name: SelloffParams
docs: Per-token sell-off policy. One entry per active token (in pool order).
All `_pct` fields are in `PERCENT_SCALE` units (10_000 = 100%).

fields.name: max_selloff_pct
docs: Max cumulative sell volume per window, as a percent of the token's
virtual balance (snapshot at window open). `0` disables the cap
AND the surge fee for this token. Must be `<= PERCENT_SCALE`.

fields.name: period_length
docs: Sliding-window length in seconds. Must be `> 0` when
`max_selloff_pct > 0`.

fields.name: fee_threshold_pct
docs: Surge fee: window-fill ratio at which the fee starts (below it the
fee is 0). Must be `< PERCENT_SCALE` when `fee_slope_high_pct > 0`.

fields.name: fee_slope_low_pct
docs: Surge fee at the threshold (lower curve point).

fields.name: fee_slope_high_pct
docs: Surge fee at ~100% window fill (upper curve point). `0` disables the
surge fee. Must be `>= fee_slope_low_pct` and `<= PERCENT_SCALE`.

types.name: Swap
docs: Emitted by `swap` after the trade executes.
# Fields
* `pool`               — pool PDA
* `user`               — signer that initiated the swap
* `token_in/out`       — mint pubkeys of the two legs
* `amount_in/out`      — raw token units (pre-fee on input side)
* `fee_amount`         — total swap fee (raw units, in token_in)
* `protocol_fee_amount`— share of `fee_amount` that went to the
protocol-fees-owed bucket (raw units, in token_in)
* `timestamp`          — `Clock::unix_timestamp`

fields.name: amount_out
docs: Amount the user RECEIVES — net of the variable sell-off surge fee.

fields.name: fee_amount
docs: Total base swap fee (raw units, in token_in).

fields.name: protocol_fee_amount
docs: Protocol share of the base swap fee (raw units, in token_in).

fields.name: surge_fee_amount
docs: Variable sell-off surge fee taken from the OUTPUT token and routed
100% to the protocol bucket. `0` in the common case.

types.name: SwapFeeRateUpdated
docs: Emitted by `set_swap_fee_rate`. Carries both old and new for cheap
audit reconstruction without re-reading prior state.

fields.name: authority
docs: Pool admin that changed the rate. Appended (wire-format append-only).

types.name: SwapsEnabledUpdated
docs: Emitted by `set_swaps_enabled`.

types.name: TokenActiveSet
docs: Emitted by `set_token_active`. Carries the token index, the old/new
`is_active` flag, and the authority that flipped it.

types.name: TokenChange
docs: Single (token_index, new_value) entry. Used by both the
virtual-balance and weight change lists.
